field.name: PWD_CUR_SNS_CMP
field.description: Power down signal of the current detector.

enumeratedValue.description: In Run Mode, 2 A. In Power Save Mode, 0.25 A

enumeratedValue.name: select_two
enumeratedValue.description: In Run Mode, 1 A. In Power Save Mode, 0.2 A

enumeratedValue.name: select_three
enumeratedValue.description: In Run Mode, 2 A. In Power Save Mode, 0.2 A

enumeratedValue.name: enabled
enumeratedValue.description: Low voltage detection comparator is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: disabled
enumeratedValue.description: Low voltage detection comparator is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: disabled
enumeratedValue.description: Overload Detection in power save mode disabled

enumeratedValue.name: enabled
enumeratedValue.description: Overload Detection in power save mode enabled

enumeratedValue.name: lp_12p5mV
enumeratedValue.description: Adjust hysteretic value in low power to 12.5mV

enumeratedValue.name: lp_25mV
enumeratedValue.description: Adjust hysteretic value in low power to 25mV

enumeratedValue.name: disabled
enumeratedValue.description: Disable xtalok detection circuit and always outputs OK signal "1"

field.name: REG_FBK_SEL
field.description: Select the feedback point of the internal regulator

enumeratedValue.name: reg_fbk_sel0
enumeratedValue.description: The regulator outputs 1.0V with 1.2V reference voltage

enumeratedValue.name: reg_fbk_sel1
enumeratedValue.description: The regulator outputs 1.1V with 1.2V reference voltage

enumeratedValue.name: reg_fbk_sel2
enumeratedValue.description: The regulator outputs 1.0V with 1.3V reference voltage

enumeratedValue.name: reg_fbk_sel3
enumeratedValue.description: The regulator outputs 1.1V with 1.3V reference voltage

field.name: REG_RLOAD_SW
field.description: This controls the load resistor of the internal regulator of DCDC

enumeratedValue.name: low_hyst_thresh
enumeratedValue.description: Lower hysteresis threshold (about 2.5mV in typical, but this value can vary with PVT corners

enumeratedValue.name: disable
enumeratedValue.description: Disable hysteresis in switching converter common mode analog comparators

enumeratedValue.name: enable
enumeratedValue.description: Enable hysteresis in switching converter common mode analog comparators

field.name: LOOPCTRL_DC_FF
field.description: Two's complement feed forward step in duty cycle in the switching DC-DC converter

field.name: LOOPCTRL_RCSCALE_THRSH
field.description: Increase the threshold detection for RC scale circuit.

enumeratedValue.name: no_increase_thrsh
enumeratedValue.description: Do not increase the threshold detection for RC scale circuit.

enumeratedValue.name: increase_thrsh
enumeratedValue.description: Increase the threshold detection for RC scale circuit.

field.name: LOOPCTRL_HYST_SIGN
field.description: Invert the sign of the hysteresis in DC-DC analog comparators.

enumeratedValue.name: noinvert
enumeratedValue.description: Do not invert sign of the hysteresis

enumeratedValue.name: idle
enumeratedValue.description: DCDC will be idle to save current dissipation when the duty cycle get to the low limit which is set by NEGLIMIT_IN.

enumeratedValue.name: not_idle
enumeratedValue.description: DCDC will keep working with the low limited duty cycle NEGLIMIT_IN.

field.name: MINPWR_DC_HALFCLK
field.description: Set DCDC clock to half frequency for continuous mode

enumeratedValue.name: fullfreq
enumeratedValue.description: DCDC clock remains at full frequency for continuous mode

enumeratedValue.name: halffreq
enumeratedValue.description: DCDC clock set to half frequency for continuous mode

enumeratedValue.name: enable
enumeratedValue.description: Enable stepping for the output of VDD_SOC of DCDC

enumeratedValue.name: disable
enumeratedValue.description: Disable stepping for the output of VDD_SOC of DCDC

enumeratedValue.name: t000001
enumeratedValue.description: Timers continue to run in Debug mode.

enumeratedValue.name: t0000011
enumeratedValue.description: Timers are stopped in Debug mode.

enumeratedValue.name: t0301
enumeratedValue.description: Clock for standard PIT timers is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: t00000111
enumeratedValue.description: Clock for standard PIT timers is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: t0331
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt requests from Timer n are disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: t077711
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt is requested whenever TIF is set.

enumeratedValue.name: timer0081
enumeratedValue.description: Timer is chained to a previous timer. For example, for channel 2, if this field is set, Timer 2 is chained to Timer 1.

peripheral.name: CMP1
peripheral.description: High-Speed Comparator (CMP), Voltage Reference (VREF) Digital-to-Analog Converter (DAC), and Analog Mux (ANMUX)

enumeratedValue.name: FILTER_CNT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Filter is disabled. If SE = 1, then COUT is a logic 0. This is not a legal state, and is not recommended. If SE = 0, COUT = COUTA.

enumeratedValue.name: FILTER_CNT_1
enumeratedValue.description: One sample must agree. The comparator output is simply sampled.

enumeratedValue.name: OPE_0
enumeratedValue.description: CMPO is not available on the associated CMPO output pin. If the comparator does not own the pin, this field has no effect.

enumeratedValue.name: OPE_1
enumeratedValue.description: CMPO is available on the associated CMPO output pin. The comparator output (CMPO) is driven out on the associated CMPO output pin if the comparator owns the pin. If the comparator does not own the field, this bit has no effect.

enumeratedValue.name: COS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Set the filtered comparator output (CMPO) to equal COUT.

enumeratedValue.name: COS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Set the unfiltered comparator output (CMPO) to equal COUTA.

enumeratedValue.name: INV_0
enumeratedValue.description: Does not invert the comparator output.

enumeratedValue.name: PMODE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Low-Speed (LS) Comparison mode selected. In this mode, CMP has slower output propagation delay and lower current consumption.

enumeratedValue.name: PMODE_1
enumeratedValue.description: High-Speed (HS) Comparison mode selected. In this mode, CMP has faster output propagation delay and higher current consumption.

enumeratedValue.name: CFF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Falling-edge on COUT has not been detected.

enumeratedValue.name: CFR_0
enumeratedValue.description: Rising-edge on COUT has not been detected.

enumeratedValue.name: VRSEL_0
enumeratedValue.description: Vin1 is selected as resistor ladder network supply reference.

enumeratedValue.name: VRSEL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Vin2 is selected as resistor ladder network supply reference.

enumeratedValue.name: SFTW_1

enumeratedValue.name: TOUT_1

enumeratedValue.description: WICT[7:0] = Time duration between interrupt and time-out is 0 seconds.

enumeratedValue.name: WICT_1
enumeratedValue.description: WICT[7:0] = Time duration between interrupt and time-out is 0.5 seconds.

enumeratedValue.name: WICT_4
enumeratedValue.description: WICT[7:0] = Time duration between interrupt and time-out is 2 seconds (Default).

enumeratedValue.name: WICT_255

enumeratedValue.name: PDE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Power Down Counter of WDOG is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: PDE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Power Down Counter of WDOG is enabled (Default).

enumeratedValue.name: DIS
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog disabled in chip stop mode.

enumeratedValue.name: EN
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog enabled in chip stop mode.

enumeratedValue.name: DIS
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog disabled in chip wait mode.

enumeratedValue.name: EN
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog enabled in chip wait mode.

enumeratedValue.name: DIS
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog disabled in chip debug mode.

enumeratedValue.name: EN
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog enabled in chip debug mode.

enumeratedValue.name: EN
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog user mode enabled. (Watchdog test mode disabled.) After testing the watchdog, software should use this setting to indicate that the watchdog is functioning normally in user mode.

enumeratedValue.name: EN_LOW
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog test mode enabled, only the low byte is used. CNT[CNTLOW] is compared with TOVAL[TOVALLOW].

enumeratedValue.name: EN_HIGH
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog test mode enabled, only the high byte is used. CNT[CNTHIGH] is compared with TOVAL[TOVALHIGH].

enumeratedValue.name: DIS
enumeratedValue.description: Updates not allowed. After the initial configuration, the watchdog cannot be later modified without forcing a reset.

enumeratedValue.name: EN
enumeratedValue.description: Updates allowed. Software can modify the watchdog configuration registers within 128 bus clocks after performing the unlock write sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: DIS
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog interrupts are disabled. Watchdog resets are not delayed.

enumeratedValue.name: EN
enumeratedValue.description: Watchdog interrupts are enabled. Watchdog resets are delayed by 128 bus clocks from the interrupt vector fetch.

field.name: CMD32EN
field.description: Enables or disables WDOG support for 32-bit (otherwise 16-bit or 8-bit) refresh/unlock command write words

enumeratedValue.name: DIS
enumeratedValue.description: Disables support for 32-bit refresh/unlock command write words. Only 16-bit or 8-bit is supported.

enumeratedValue.name: EN
enumeratedValue.description: Enables support for 32-bit refresh/unlock command write words. 16-bit or 8-bit is NOT supported.

field.name: ADSTS
field.description: Defines the total sample time duration in number of full cycles

enumeratedValue.name: ADSTS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Sample period (ADC clocks) = 3 if ADLSMP=0b Sample period (ADC clocks) = 13 if ADLSMP=1b

enumeratedValue.name: ADSTS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Sample period (ADC clocks) = 5 if ADLSMP=0b Sample period (ADC clocks) = 17 if ADLSMP=1b

enumeratedValue.name: ADSTS_2
enumeratedValue.description: Sample period (ADC clocks) = 7 if ADLSMP=0b Sample period (ADC clocks) = 21 if ADLSMP=1b

enumeratedValue.name: ADSTS_3
enumeratedValue.description: Sample period (ADC clocks) = 9 if ADLSMP=0b Sample period (ADC clocks) = 25 if ADLSMP=1b

enumeratedValue.name: OVWREN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable the overwriting. Existing Data in Data result register will not be overwritten by subsequent converted data.

enumeratedValue.name: ADACKEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Asynchronous clock output disabled; Asynchronous clock only enabled if selected by ADICLK and a conversion is active.

enumeratedValue.name: ADACKEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Asynchronous clock and clock output enabled regardless of the state of the ADC

enumeratedValue.name: ACREN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Range function disabled. Only the compare value 1 of ADC_CV register (CV1) is compared.

enumeratedValue.name: ACREN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Range function enabled. Both compare values of ADC_CV registers (CV1 and CV2) are compared.

enumeratedValue.name: ACFGT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Configures "Less Than Threshold, Outside Range Not Inclusive and Inside Range Not Inclusive" functionality based on the values placed in the ADC_CV register.

enumeratedValue.name: ACFGT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Configures "Greater Than Or Equal To Threshold, Outside Range Inclusive and Inside Range Inclusive" functionality based on the values placed in the ADC_CV registers.

enumeratedValue.name: ADCO_0
enumeratedValue.description: One conversion or one set of conversions if the hardware average function is enabled (AVGE=1) after initiating a conversion.

enumeratedValue.name: ADCO_1
enumeratedValue.description: Continuous conversions or sets of conversions if the hardware average function is enabled (AVGE=1) after initiating a conversion.

enumeratedValue.name: CALF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Calibration failed. ADC accuracy specifications are not guaranteed.

enumeratedValue.name: AWKST_1
enumeratedValue.description: Asynchronous wake up interrupt occurred in stop mode.

enumeratedValue.name: SIGN_0
enumeratedValue.description: The offset value is added with the raw result

enumeratedValue.name: SIGN_1
enumeratedValue.description: The offset value is subtracted from the raw converted value

enumeratedValue.name: SAMP_MODE_VON_BOTH
enumeratedValue.description: use Von Neumann data into both Entropy shifter and Statistical Checker

enumeratedValue.name: SAMP_MODE_RAW_BOTH
enumeratedValue.description: use raw data into both Entropy shifter and Statistical Checker

enumeratedValue.name: SAMP_MODE_VON_ENT
enumeratedValue.description: use Von Neumann data into Entropy shifter. Use raw data into Statistical Checker

enumeratedValue.name: OSC_DIV_DIV1
enumeratedValue.description: use ring oscillator with no divide

field.name: ZMK_WSL

enumeratedValue.name: READ_ALLOWED

field.name: GPR_SL

field.name: LPSECR_SL

field.name: MKS_SL

field.name: HPSICR_L

field.name: HAC_L

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Secure to Trusted State transition is disabled

field.name: SSM_SFNS_DIS

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Soft Fail to Non-Secure State transition is disabled

field.name: LP_SWR
field.description: LP Software Reset When set to 1, most registers in the SNVS_LP section are reset, but the following registers are not reset by an LP software reset: Monotonic Counter Secure Real Time Counter Time Alarm Register This bit cannot be set when the LP_SWR_DIS bit is set

field.name: LP_SWR_DIS
field.description: LP Software Reset Disable When set, disables the LP software reset

field.name: SW_SV
field.description: Software Security Violation When set, the system security monitor treats this bit as a non-fatal security violation

field.name: SW_FSV
field.description: Software Fatal Security Violation When set, the system security monitor treats this bit as a fatal security violation

field.name: SW_LPSV
field.description: LP Software Security Violation When set, SNVS_LP treats this bit as a security violation

field.name: PROG_ZMK
field.description: Program Zeroizable Master Key This bit activates ZMK hardware programming mechanism

field.name: MKS_EN
field.description: Master Key Select Enable When not set, the one time programmable (OTP) master key is selected by default

enumeratedValue.name: SELECT_OTP
enumeratedValue.description: OTP master key is selected as an SNVS master key

enumeratedValue.name: SELECT_PER_LPMKCR
enumeratedValue.description: SNVS master key is selected according to the setting of the MASTER_KEY_SEL field of LPMKCR

field.name: HAC_EN
field.description: High Assurance Counter Enable This bit controls the SSM transition from the soft fail to the hard fail state

field.name: HAC_LOAD
field.description: High Assurance Counter Load When set, it loads the High Assurance Counter Register with the value of the High Assurance Counter Load Register

field.name: HAC_CLEAR
field.description: High Assurance Counter Clear When set, it clears the High Assurance Counter Register

field.name: HAC_STOP
field.description: High Assurance Counter Stop This bit can be set only when SSM is in soft fail state

field.name: NPSWA_EN
field.description: Non-Privileged Software Access Enable When set, allows non-privileged software to access all SNVS registers, including those that are privileged software read/write access only

field.name: HPTA_EN
field.description: HP Time Alarm Enable When set, the time alarm interrupt is generated if the value in the HP Time Alarm Registers is equal to the value of the HP Real Time Counter

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: HP Time Alarm Interrupt is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: HP Time Alarm Interrupt is enabled

field.name: DIS_PI
field.description: Disable periodic interrupt in the functional interrupt

enumeratedValue.description: Periodic interrupt will trigger a functional interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disable periodic interrupt in the function interrupt

field.name: PI_EN

field.name: PI_FREQ

field.name: REFTOP_PWD
field.description: Control bit to power-down the analog bandgap reference circuitry

field.name: REFTOP_SELFBIASOFF
field.description: Control bit to disable the self-bias circuit in the analog bandgap

enumeratedValue.name: REFTOP_SELFBIASOFF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Uses coarse bias currents for startup

enumeratedValue.name: REFTOP_SELFBIASOFF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Uses bandgap-based bias currents for best performance.

field.name: REFTOP_VBGADJ
field.description: Not related to CCM. See Power Management Unit (PMU)

field.name: REFTOP_VBGUP
field.description: Status bit that signals the analog bandgap voltage is up and stable

field.name: STOP_MODE_CONFIG
field.description: Configure the analog behavior in stop mode.

enumeratedValue.name: STOP_MODE_CONFIG_0
enumeratedValue.description: All analog except RTC powered down on stop mode assertion.

enumeratedValue.name: STOP_MODE_CONFIG_1
enumeratedValue.description: Beside RTC, analog bandgap, 1p1 and 2p5 regulators are also on.

enumeratedValue.name: STOP_MODE_CONFIG_2
enumeratedValue.description: Beside RTC, 1p1 and 2p5 regulators are also on, low-power bandgap is selected so that the normal analog bandgap together with the rest analog is powered down.

enumeratedValue.name: STOP_MODE_CONFIG_3
enumeratedValue.description: Beside RTC, low-power bandgap is selected and the rest analog is powered down.

field.name: DISCON_HIGH_SNVS
field.description: This bit controls a switch from VDD_HIGH_IN to VDD_SNVS_IN.

field.name: OSC_I
field.description: This field determines the bias current in the 24MHz oscillator

field.name: OSC_XTALOK
field.description: Status bit that signals that the output of the 24-MHz crystal oscillator is stable

field.name: OSC_XTALOK_EN
field.description: This bit enables the detector that signals when the 24MHz crystal oscillator is stable

field.name: CLKGATE_CTRL
field.description: This bit allows disabling the clock gate (always ungated) for the xtal 24MHz clock that clocks the digital logic in the analog block

enumeratedValue.name: ALLOW_AUTO_GATE
enumeratedValue.description: Allow the logic to automatically gate the clock when the XTAL is powered down.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_AUTO_GATE
enumeratedValue.description: Prevent the logic from ever gating off the clock.

field.name: CLKGATE_DELAY
field.description: This field specifies the delay between powering up the XTAL 24MHz clock and releasing the clock to the digital logic inside the analog block

field.name: RTC_XTAL_SOURCE
field.description: This field indicates which chip source is being used for the rtc clock

field.name: XTAL_24M_PWD
field.description: This field powers down the 24M crystal oscillator if set true

field.name: REFTOP_PWD
field.description: Control bit to power-down the analog bandgap reference circuitry

field.name: REFTOP_SELFBIASOFF
field.description: Control bit to disable the self-bias circuit in the analog bandgap

enumeratedValue.name: REFTOP_SELFBIASOFF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Uses coarse bias currents for startup

enumeratedValue.name: REFTOP_SELFBIASOFF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Uses bandgap-based bias currents for best performance.

field.name: REFTOP_VBGADJ
field.description: Not related to CCM. See Power Management Unit (PMU)

field.name: REFTOP_VBGUP
field.description: Status bit that signals the analog bandgap voltage is up and stable

field.name: STOP_MODE_CONFIG
field.description: Configure the analog behavior in stop mode.

enumeratedValue.name: STOP_MODE_CONFIG_0
enumeratedValue.description: All analog except RTC powered down on stop mode assertion.

enumeratedValue.name: STOP_MODE_CONFIG_1
enumeratedValue.description: Beside RTC, analog bandgap, 1p1 and 2p5 regulators are also on.

enumeratedValue.name: STOP_MODE_CONFIG_2
enumeratedValue.description: Beside RTC, 1p1 and 2p5 regulators are also on, low-power bandgap is selected so that the normal analog bandgap together with the rest analog is powered down.

enumeratedValue.name: STOP_MODE_CONFIG_3
enumeratedValue.description: Beside RTC, low-power bandgap is selected and the rest analog is powered down.

field.name: DISCON_HIGH_SNVS
field.description: This bit controls a switch from VDD_HIGH_IN to VDD_SNVS_IN.

field.name: OSC_I
field.description: This field determines the bias current in the 24MHz oscillator

field.name: OSC_XTALOK
field.description: Status bit that signals that the output of the 24-MHz crystal oscillator is stable

field.name: OSC_XTALOK_EN
field.description: This bit enables the detector that signals when the 24MHz crystal oscillator is stable

field.name: CLKGATE_CTRL
field.description: This bit allows disabling the clock gate (always ungated) for the xtal 24MHz clock that clocks the digital logic in the analog block

enumeratedValue.name: ALLOW_AUTO_GATE
enumeratedValue.description: Allow the logic to automatically gate the clock when the XTAL is powered down.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_AUTO_GATE
enumeratedValue.description: Prevent the logic from ever gating off the clock.

field.name: CLKGATE_DELAY
field.description: This field specifies the delay between powering up the XTAL 24MHz clock and releasing the clock to the digital logic inside the analog block

field.name: RTC_XTAL_SOURCE
field.description: This field indicates which chip source is being used for the rtc clock

field.name: XTAL_24M_PWD
field.description: This field powers down the 24M crystal oscillator if set true

field.name: ENABLE_BO
field.description: Control bit to enable the brownout circuitry in the regulator.

field.name: ENABLE_ILIMIT
field.description: Control bit to enable the current-limit circuitry in the regulator.

field.name: BO_OFFSET
field.description: Control bits to adjust the regulator brownout offset voltage in 25mV steps

field.name: VBUS_SEL
field.description: Select input voltage source for LDO_3P0 from either USB_OTG1_VBUS or USB_OTG2_VBUS

field.name: OUTPUT_TRG
field.description: Control bits to adjust the regulator output voltage

field.name: BO_VDD3P0
field.description: Status bit that signals when a brownout is detected on the regulator output.

field.name: OK_VDD3P0
field.description: Status bit that signals when the regulator output is ok. 1 = regulator output > brownout target

field.name: REG0_TARG
field.description: This field defines the target voltage for the Arm core power domain

enumeratedValue.name: REG0_TARG_31
enumeratedValue.description: Power FET switched full on. No regulation.

field.name: REG0_ADJ
field.description: This bit field defines the adjustment bits to calibrate the target value of Reg0. The adjustment is applied on top on any adjustment applied to the global reference in the misc0 register.

field.name: REG1_TARG
field.description: This bit field defines the target voltage for the vpu/gpu power domain. Single bit increments reflect 25mV core voltage steps. Not all steps will make sense to use either because of input supply limitations or load operation.

enumeratedValue.name: REG1_TARG_31
enumeratedValue.description: Power FET switched full on. No regulation.

field.name: REG1_ADJ
field.description: This bit field defines the adjustment bits to calibrate the target value of Reg1. The adjustment is applied on top on any adjustment applied to the global reference in the misc0 register.

field.name: REG2_TARG
field.description: This field defines the target voltage for the SOC power domain

enumeratedValue.name: REG2_TARG_31
enumeratedValue.description: Power FET switched full on. No regulation.

field.name: REG2_ADJ
field.description: This bit field defines the adjustment bits to calibrate the target value of Reg2. The adjustment is applied on top on any adjustment applied to the global reference in the misc0 register.

field.name: FET_ODRIVE
field.description: If set, increases the gate drive on power gating FETs to reduce leakage in the off state

field.name: REFTOP_PWD
field.description: Control bit to power-down the analog bandgap reference circuitry

field.name: REFTOP_PWDVBGUP
field.description: Control bit to power down the VBG-up detection circuitry in the analog bandgap.

field.name: REFTOP_LOWPOWER
field.description: Control bit to enable the low-power mode in the analog bandgap.

field.name: REFTOP_SELFBIASOFF
field.description: Control bit to disable the self-bias circuit in the analog bandgap

enumeratedValue.name: REFTOP_SELFBIASOFF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Uses coarse bias currents for startup

enumeratedValue.name: REFTOP_SELFBIASOFF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Uses bandgap-based bias currents for best performance.

field.name: REFTOP_VBGUP
field.description: Status bit that signals the analog bandgap voltage is up and stable. 1 - Stable.

field.name: STOP_MODE_CONFIG
field.description: Configure the analog behavior in stop mode.

field.name: DISCON_HIGH_SNVS
field.description: This bit controls a switch from VDD_HIGH_IN to VDD_SNVS_IN.

field.name: OSC_I
field.description: This field determines the bias current in the 24MHz oscillator

field.name: OSC_XTALOK
field.description: Status bit that signals that the output of the 24-MHz crystal oscillator is stable

field.name: OSC_XTALOK_EN
field.description: This bit enables the detector that signals when the 24MHz crystal oscillator is stable

field.name: CLKGATE_CTRL
field.description: This bit allows disabling the clock gate (always ungated) for the xtal 24MHz clock that clocks the digital logic in the analog block

enumeratedValue.name: ALLOW_AUTO_GATE
enumeratedValue.description: Allow the logic to automatically gate the clock when the XTAL is powered down.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_AUTO_GATE
enumeratedValue.description: Prevent the logic from ever gating off the clock.

field.name: CLKGATE_DELAY
field.description: This field specifies the delay between powering up the XTAL 24MHz clock and releasing the clock to the digital logic inside the analog block

field.name: RTC_XTAL_SOURCE
field.description: This field indicates which chip source is being used for the rtc clock.

field.name: XTAL_24M_PWD
field.description: This field powers down the 24M crystal oscillator if set true.

field.name: VID_PLL_PREDIV
field.description: Predivider for the source clock of the PLL's.

enumeratedValue.description: Updates the temperature value at a RTC clock rate.

enumeratedValue.description: Updates the temperature value at a RTC/2 clock rate.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_AUTO_GATE
enumeratedValue.description: Prevent the logic from ever gating off the clock.

field.name: CLKGATE_DELAY
field.description: This field specifies the delay between powering up the XTAL 24MHz clock and releasing the clock to the digital logic inside the analog block

field.name: ENHOSTDISCONDETECT
field.description: For host mode, enables high-speed disconnect detector

field.name: ENIRQHOSTDISCON
field.description: Enables interrupt for detection of disconnection to Device when in high-speed host mode

field.name: HOSTDISCONDETECT_IRQ
field.description: Indicates that the device has disconnected in high-speed mode

field.name: ENDEVPLUGINDETECT
field.description: For device mode, enables 200-KOhm pullups for detecting connectivity to the host.

field.name: DEVPLUGIN_POLARITY
field.description: For device mode, if this bit is cleared to 0, then it trips the interrupt if the device is plugged in

field.name: OTG_ID_CHG_IRQ
field.description: OTG ID change interrupt. Indicates the value of ID pin changed.

field.name: ENOTGIDDETECT
field.description: Enables circuit to detect resistance of MiniAB ID pin.

field.name: RESUMEIRQSTICKY
field.description: Set to 1 will make RESUME_IRQ bit a sticky bit until software clear it

field.name: ENIRQRESUMEDETECT
field.description: Enables interrupt for detection of a non-J state on the USB line

field.name: RESUME_IRQ
field.description: Indicates that the host is sending a wake-up after suspend

field.name: ENIRQDEVPLUGIN
field.description: Enables interrupt for the detection of connectivity to the USB line.

field.name: DEVPLUGIN_IRQ
field.description: Indicates that the device is connected

field.name: DATA_ON_LRADC
field.description: Enables the LRADC to monitor USB_DP and USB_DM. This is for use in non-USB modes only.

field.name: ENUTMILEVEL2
field.description: Enables UTMI+ Level2. This should be enabled if needs to support LS device

field.name: ENIRQWAKEUP
field.description: Enables interrupt for the wakeup events.

field.name: WAKEUP_IRQ
field.description: Indicates that there is a wakeup event

field.name: ENAUTO_PWRON_PLL
field.description: Enables the feature to auto-enable the POWER bit of HW_CLKCTRL_PLLxCTRL0 if there is wakeup event if USB is suspended

field.name: ENAUTOCLR_CLKGATE
field.description: Enables the feature to auto-clear the CLKGATE bit if there is wakeup event while USB is suspended

field.name: ENAUTOCLR_PHY_PWD
field.description: Enables the feature to auto-clear the PWD register bits in USBPHYx_PWD if there is wakeup event while USB is suspended

field.name: ENDPDMCHG_WKUP
field.description: Enables the feature to wakeup USB if DP/DM is toggled when USB is suspended

field.name: ENIDCHG_WKUP
field.description: Enables the feature to wakeup USB if ID is toggled when USB is suspended.

field.name: ENVBUSCHG_WKUP
field.description: Enables the feature to wakeup USB if VBUS is toggled when USB is suspended.

field.name: FSDLL_RST_EN
field.description: Enables the feature to reset the FSDLL lock detection logic at the end of each TX packet.

field.name: OTG_ID_VALUE
field.description: Almost same as OTGID_STATUS in USBPHYx_STATUS Register

field.name: HOST_FORCE_LS_SE0
field.description: Forces the next FS packet that is transmitted to have a EOP with LS timing

field.name: UTMI_SUSPENDM
field.description: Used by the PHY to indicate a powered-down state

field.name: SFTRST
field.description: Writing a 1 to this bit will soft-reset the USBPHYx_PWD, USBPHYx_TX, USBPHYx_RX, and USBPHYx_CTRL registers

register.name: TCD_NBYTES_MLNO
register.description: TCD Minor Byte Count (Minor Loop Mapping Disabled)

register.name: TCD_NBYTES_MLOFFNO
register.description: TCD Signed Minor Loop Offset (Minor Loop Mapping Enabled and Offset Disabled)

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: The minor loop offset is not applied to the DADDR

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: The minor loop offset is applied to the DADDR

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: The minor loop offset is not applied to the SADDR

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: The minor loop offset is applied to the SADDR

register.name: TCD_NBYTES_MLOFFYES
register.description: TCD Signed Minor Loop Offset (Minor Loop Mapping and Offset Enabled)

field.name: MLOFF
field.description: If SMLOE = 1 or DMLOE = 1, this field represents a sign-extended offset applied to the source or destination address to form the next-state value after the minor loop completes.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: The minor loop offset is not applied to the DADDR

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: The minor loop offset is applied to the DADDR

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: The minor loop offset is not applied to the SADDR

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: The minor loop offset is applied to the SADDR

register.name: TCD_CITER_ELINKNO
register.description: TCD Current Minor Loop Link, Major Loop Count (Channel Linking Disabled)

field.name: ELINK
field.description: Enable channel-to-channel linking on minor-loop complete

register.name: TCD_CITER_ELINKYES
register.description: TCD Current Minor Loop Link, Major Loop Count (Channel Linking Enabled)

field.name: ELINK
field.description: Enable channel-to-channel linking on minor-loop complete

register.name: TCD_DLASTSGA
register.description: TCD Last Destination Address Adjustment/Scatter Gather Address

field.name: DLASTSGA
field.description: Destination last address adjustment, or next memory address TCD for channel (scatter/gather)

enumeratedValue.name: START
enumeratedValue.description: Channel is explicitly started via a software initiated service request

field.name: INTMAJOR
field.description: Enable an interrupt when major iteration count completes.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: End of major loop interrupt is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: End of major loop interrupt is enabled

field.name: INTHALF
field.description: Enable an interrupt when major counter is half complete.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_CLEAR
enumeratedValue.description: The channel's ERQ field is not affected

enumeratedValue.name: CLEAR
enumeratedValue.description: The channel's ERQ field value changes to 0 when the major loop is complete

enumeratedValue.name: NORMAL
enumeratedValue.description: The current channel's TCD is normal format

enumeratedValue.name: SCATTER
enumeratedValue.description: The current channel's TCD specifies a scatter gather format

field.name: MAJORELINK
field.description: Enable channel-to-channel linking on major loop complete

enumeratedValue.name: STALL4
enumeratedValue.description: eDMA engine stalls for 4 cycles after each R/W

enumeratedValue.name: STALL8
enumeratedValue.description: eDMA engine stalls for 8 cycles after each R/W

register.name: TCD_BITER_ELINKNO
register.description: TCD Beginning Minor Loop Link, Major Loop Count (Channel Linking Disabled)

field.name: ELINK
field.description: Enables channel-to-channel linking on minor loop complete

register.name: TCD_BITER_ELINKYES
register.description: TCD Beginning Minor Loop Link, Major Loop Count (Channel Linking Enabled)

field.name: ELINK
field.description: Enables channel-to-channel linking on minor loop complete

enumeratedValue.name: A_ON_0
enumeratedValue.description: DMA Channel Always ON function is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: A_ON_1
enumeratedValue.description: DMA Channel Always ON function is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: TRIG_0
enumeratedValue.description: Triggering is disabled. If triggering is disabled and ENBL is set, the DMA Channel will simply route the specified source to the DMA channel. (Normal mode)

enumeratedValue.name: TRIG_1
enumeratedValue.description: Triggering is enabled. If triggering is enabled and ENBL is set, the DMA_CH_MUX is in Periodic Trigger mode.

field.name: MEGA_PDN_REQ
field.description: MEGA domain (FlexRAM PDRAM1) power down request

field.name: MEGA_PUP_REQ
field.description: MEGA domain (FlexRAM PDRAM1) power up request

enumeratedValue.name: PDRAM0_PGE_0
enumeratedValue.description: FlexRAM PDRAM0 domain will keep power even if the CPU core is powered down.

enumeratedValue.name: PDRAM0_PGE_1
enumeratedValue.description: FlexRAM PDRAM0 domain will be powered down when the CPU core is powered down..

field.name: IMR1
field.description: IRQ[31:0] masking bits: 1-irq masked, 0-irq is not masked

field.name: IMR2
field.description: IRQ[63:32] masking bits: 1-irq masked, 0-irq is not masked

field.name: IMR3
field.description: IRQ[95:64] masking bits: 1-irq masked, 0-irq is not masked

field.name: IMR4
field.description: IRQ[127:96] masking bits: 1-irq masked, 0-irq is not masked

field.name: IMR5
field.description: IRQ[159:128] masking bits: 1-irq masked, 0-irq is not masked

field.name: PCR
field.description: Power Control PCR must not change from power-down request (pdn_req) assertion until the target subsystem is completely powered up

enumeratedValue.name: PCR_0
enumeratedValue.description: Do not switch off power even if pdn_req is asserted.

enumeratedValue.name: PCR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Switch off power when pdn_req is asserted.

register.name: MEGA_PUPSCR
register.description: PGC Mega Power Up Sequence Control Register

field.name: SW
field.description: After a power-up request (pup_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of IPG clocks equal to the value of SW before asserting power toggle on/off signal (switch_b) to switch on power

field.name: SW2ISO
field.description: After asserting power toggle on/off signal (switch_b) to switch on power, the PGC waits a number of IPG clocks equal to the value of SW2ISO before negating isolation

register.name: MEGA_PDNSCR
register.description: PGC Mega Pull Down Sequence Control Register

field.name: ISO
field.description: After a power-down request (pdn_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of IPG clocks equal to the value of ISO before asserting isolation

field.name: ISO2SW
field.description: After asserting isolation, the PGC waits a number of IPG clocks equal to the value of ISO2SW before negating power toggle on/off signal (switch_b) to switch off power

register.name: MEGA_SR
register.description: PGC Mega Power Gating Controller Status Register

enumeratedValue.name: PSR_0
enumeratedValue.description: The target subsystem was not powered down for the previous power-down request.

enumeratedValue.name: PSR_1
enumeratedValue.description: The target subsystem was powered down for the previous power-down request.

field.name: PCR
field.description: Power Control PCR must not change from power-down request (pdn_req) assertion until the target subsystem is completely powered up

enumeratedValue.name: PCR_0
enumeratedValue.description: Do not switch off power even if pdn_req is asserted.

enumeratedValue.name: PCR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Switch off power when pdn_req is asserted.

register.name: CPU_PUPSCR
register.description: PGC CPU Power Up Sequence Control Register

field.name: SW
field.description: After a power-up request (pup_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of IPG clocks equal to the value of SW before asserting power toggle on/off signal (switch_b) to switch on power

field.name: SW2ISO
field.description: After asserting power toggle on/off signal (switch_b) to switch on power, the PGC waits a number of IPG clocks equal to the value of SW2ISO before negating isolation

register.name: CPU_PDNSCR

field.name: ISO
field.description: After a power-down request (pdn_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of IPG clocks equal to the value of ISO before asserting isolation

field.name: ISO2SW
field.description: After asserting isolation, the PGC waits a number of IPG clocks equal to the value of ISO2SW before negating power toggle on/off signal (switch_b) to switch off power

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Receiver and transmitter use 7-bit to 9-bit data characters.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Receiver and transmitter use 10-bit data characters.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enables automatic address matching or data matching mode for MATCH[MA2].

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enables automatic address matching or data matching mode for MATCH[MA1].

enumeratedValue.name: NOMATCH
enumeratedValue.description: Received data is not equal to MA2

enumeratedValue.name: MATCH
enumeratedValue.description: Received data is equal to MA2

enumeratedValue.name: NOMATCH
enumeratedValue.description: Received data is not equal to MA1

enumeratedValue.name: MATCH
enumeratedValue.description: Received data is equal to MA1

enumeratedValue.name: NOERROR
enumeratedValue.description: No framing error detected. This does not guarantee the framing is correct.

enumeratedValue.name: NOISE
enumeratedValue.description: Noise detected in the received character in the DATA register.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_RXDATA
enumeratedValue.description: Receive FIFO level is less than watermark.

enumeratedValue.name: RXDATA
enumeratedValue.description: Receive FIFO level is equal or greater than watermark.

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: Transmitter active (sending data, a preamble, or a break).

enumeratedValue.name: TXDATA
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit FIFO level is greater than watermark.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_TXDATA
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit FIFO level is equal or less than watermark.

enumeratedValue.name: IDLE
enumeratedValue.description: LPUART receiver idle waiting for a start bit.

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: LPUART receiver active (RXD input not idle).

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: LIN break detect is disabled, normal break character can be detected.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: LIN break detect is enabled. LIN break character is detected at length of 11 bit times (if M = 0) or 12 (if M = 1) or 13 (M10 = 1).

enumeratedValue.name: SHORT
enumeratedValue.description: Break character is transmitted with length of 9 to 13 bit times.

enumeratedValue.name: LONG
enumeratedValue.description: Break character is transmitted with length of 12 to 15 bit times.

enumeratedValue.name: IDLE_NOTSET
enumeratedValue.description: During receive standby state (RWU = 1), the IDLE bit does not get set upon detection of an idle character. During address match wakeup, the IDLE bit does not set when an address does not match.

enumeratedValue.name: IDLE_SET
enumeratedValue.description: During receive standby state (RWU = 1), the IDLE bit gets set upon detection of an idle character. During address match wakeup, the IDLE bit does set when an address does not match.

enumeratedValue.name: LSB_FIRST
enumeratedValue.description: LSB (bit0) is the first bit that is transmitted following the start bit. Further, the first bit received after the start bit is identified as bit0.

enumeratedValue.name: MSB_FIRST
enumeratedValue.description: MSB (identified as bit9, bit8, bit7 or bit6) is the first bit that is transmitted following the start bit depending on the setting of CTRL[M], CTRL[PE] and BAUD[M10]. .

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DETECTED

enumeratedValue.name: FROM_START
enumeratedValue.description: Idle character bit count starts after start bit.

enumeratedValue.name: FROM_STOP
enumeratedValue.description: Idle character bit count starts after stop bit.

enumeratedValue.name: DATA8
enumeratedValue.description: Receiver and transmitter use 8-bit data characters.

enumeratedValue.name: DATA9

enumeratedValue.name: NO_EFFECT

enumeratedValue.name: ONEWIRE

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: LPUART is enabled in Doze mode.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED

enumeratedValue.name: NOFFECT
enumeratedValue.description: Normal operation - RXD and TXD use separate pins.

enumeratedValue.name: LOOPBACK
enumeratedValue.description: Loop mode or single-wire mode where transmitter outputs are internally connected to receiver input (see RSRC bit).

enumeratedValue.name: NO_EFFECT
enumeratedValue.description: Receiver and transmitter use 8-bit to 10-bit data characters.

enumeratedValue.name: DATA7

enumeratedValue.description: Queue break character(s) to be sent.

enumeratedValue.description: LPUART receiver in standby waiting for wakeup condition.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware interrupt is requested when IDLE flag is 1.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware interrupt is requested when RDRF flag is 1.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware interrupt is requested when TC flag is 1.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware interrupt is requested when TDRE flag is 1.

enumeratedValue.description: Hardware interrupt is requested when PF is set.

enumeratedValue.description: Hardware interrupt is requested when FE is set.

field.name: TXDIR

enumeratedValue.description: TXD pin is an input in single-wire mode.

enumeratedValue.name: TX_OUTPUT
enumeratedValue.description: TXD pin is an output in single-wire mode.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_IDLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receiver was not idle before receiving this character.

enumeratedValue.name: IDLE
enumeratedValue.description: Receiver was idle before receiving this character.

enumeratedValue.name: EMPTY
enumeratedValue.description: Receive buffer is empty, data returned on read is not valid.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: The dataword is received without a frame error on read, or transmit a normal character on write.

enumeratedValue.name: ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: The dataword is received with a frame error, or transmit an idle or break character on transmit.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_PARITY
enumeratedValue.description: The dataword is received without a parity error.

enumeratedValue.name: PARITY
enumeratedValue.description: The dataword is received with a parity error.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_NOISE
enumeratedValue.description: The dataword is received without noise.

enumeratedValue.name: NOISE
enumeratedValue.description: The data is received with noise.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: CTS has no effect on the transmitter.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enables clear-to-send operation. The transmitter checks the state of CTS each time it is ready to send a character. If CTS is asserted, the character is sent. If CTS is deasserted, the signal TXD remains in the mark state and transmission is delayed until CTS is asserted. Changes in CTS as a character is being sent do not affect its transmission.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: The transmitter has no effect on RTS.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: When a character is placed into an empty transmit shift register, RTS asserts one bit time before the start bit is transmitted. RTS deasserts one bit time after all characters in the transmitter FIFO and shift register are completely sent, including the last stop bit.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: The receiver has no effect on RTS.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: RTS is deasserted if the receiver data register is full or a start bit has been detected that would cause the receiver data register to become full. RTS is asserted if the receiver data register is not full and has not detected a start bit that would cause the receiver data register to become full.

enumeratedValue.name: START
enumeratedValue.description: CTS input is sampled at the start of each character.

enumeratedValue.name: IDLE
enumeratedValue.description: CTS input is sampled when the transmitter is idle.

enumeratedValue.name: CTS
enumeratedValue.description: CTS input is the CTS_B pin.

enumeratedValue.name: MATCH
enumeratedValue.description: CTS input is an internal connection to the receiver address match result.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Receive FIFO is enabled. Buffer depth is indicted by RXFIFOSIZE.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit FIFO is not enabled. Buffer depth is 1.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit FIFO is enabled. Buffer depth is indicated by TXFIFOSIZE.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: RXUF flag does not generate an interrupt to the host.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: RXUF flag generates an interrupt to the host.

enumeratedValue.description: TXOF flag does not generate an interrupt to the host.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: TXOF flag generates an interrupt to the host.

enumeratedValue.description: Enable RDRF assertion due to partially filled FIFO when receiver is idle for 32 characters.

enumeratedValue.name: IDLE_64
enumeratedValue.description: Enable RDRF assertion due to partially filled FIFO when receiver is idle for 64 characters.

enumeratedValue.name: RXFIFO_RST
enumeratedValue.description: All data in the receive FIFO/buffer is cleared out.

enumeratedValue.name: TXFIFO_RST
enumeratedValue.description: All data in the transmit FIFO is cleared out.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_UNDERFLOW

field.name: MAXMB
field.description: This 7-bit field defines the number of the last Message Buffers that will take part in the matching and arbitration processes

field.name: IDAM
field.description: This 2-bit field identifies the format of the elements of the Rx FIFO filter table, as shown below

enumeratedValue.name: IDAM_0
enumeratedValue.description: Format A One full ID (standard or extended) per ID filter Table element.

enumeratedValue.name: IDAM_1
enumeratedValue.description: Format B Two full standard IDs or two partial 14-bit extended IDs per ID filter Table element.

enumeratedValue.name: IDAM_2
enumeratedValue.description: Format C Four partial 8-bit IDs (standard or extended) per ID filter Table element.

field.name: AEN
field.description: This bit is supplied for backwards compatibility reasons

field.name: LPRIOEN
field.description: This bit is provided for backwards compatibility reasons

field.name: IRMQ
field.description: This bit indicates whether Rx matching process will be based either on individual masking and queue or on masking scheme with RXMGMASK, RX14MASK and RX15MASK, RXFGMASK

enumeratedValue.name: IRMQ_0
enumeratedValue.description: Individual Rx masking and queue feature are disabled.For backward compatibility, the reading of C/S word locks the MB even if it is EMPTY.

enumeratedValue.name: IRMQ_1
enumeratedValue.description: Individual Rx masking and queue feature are enabled.

field.name: SRXDIS
field.description: This bit defines whether FlexCAN is allowed to receive frames transmitted by itself

field.name: WAKSRC

field.description: Entire Frame Arbitration Field Comparison Enable For Rx Mailboxes

enumeratedValue.name: RTR_compare_no
enumeratedValue.description: Rx mailbox filter's IDE bit is always compared and RTR is never compared despite mask bits.

enumeratedValue.name: RTR_compare_yes
enumeratedValue.description: Enables the comparison of both Rx mailbox filter's IDE and RTR bit with their corresponding bits within the incoming frame. Mask bits do apply.

enumeratedValue.name: id2
enumeratedValue.description: Matching starts from Rx FIFO and continues on mailboxes.

enumeratedValue.name: id4
enumeratedValue.description: Matching starts from mailboxes and continues on Rx FIFO.

field.name: ERRMSK_FAST
field.description: Error Interrupt Mask for errors detected in the data phase of fast CAN FD frames

enumeratedValue.name: inactive_mailbox_no
enumeratedValue.description: If ESR2[VPS] is asserted, the ESR2[LPTM] is not an inactive mailbox.

enumeratedValue.name: inactive_mailbox_yes
enumeratedValue.description: If ESR2[VPS] is asserted, there is at least one inactive mailbox. LPTM content is the number of the first one.

enumeratedValue.name: invalid
enumeratedValue.description: Contents of IMB and LPTM are invalid.

enumeratedValue.name: valid
enumeratedValue.description: Contents of IMB and LPTM are valid.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: EXT
field.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: PRIO
field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE

field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: EXT
field.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: PRIO
field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.name: PRIO

field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: PRIO

enumeratedValue.name: in_range
enumeratedValue.description: Measured loop delay is in range.

enumeratedValue.name: out_of_range
enumeratedValue.description: Measured loop delay is out of range.

field.name: MBDSR0
field.description: Message Buffer Data Size for Region 0

field.name: MBDSR1
field.description: Message Buffer Data Size for Region 1

enumeratedValue.name: nominal
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit a frame in nominal rate. The BRS bit in the Tx MB has no effect.

enumeratedValue.name: bit_rate_switching
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit a frame with bit rate switching if the BRS bit in the Tx MB is recessive.

enumeratedValue.name: CLEAR_OFLAG
enumeratedValue.description: Clear OFLAG output on successful compare

enumeratedValue.name: SET_OFLAG
enumeratedValue.description: Set OFLAG output on successful compare

enumeratedValue.name: TOGGLE_OFLAG_SUCCESS
enumeratedValue.description: Toggle OFLAG output on successful compare

enumeratedValue.name: TOGGLE_OFLAG_ALT
enumeratedValue.description: Toggle OFLAG output using alternating compare registers

enumeratedValue.name: CLEAR_ON_SECONDARY
enumeratedValue.description: Set on compare, cleared on secondary source input edge

enumeratedValue.name: CLEAR_ON_ROLLOVER
enumeratedValue.description: Set on compare, cleared on counter rollover

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE_GATED_OUT
enumeratedValue.description: Enable gated clock output while counter is active

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Co-channel counter/timers cannot force a re-initialization of this counter/timer

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Co-channel counter/timers may force a re-initialization of this counter/timer

enumeratedValue.name: UNTIL_ROLLOVER
enumeratedValue.description: Count until roll over at $FFFF and continue from $0000.

enumeratedValue.name: UNTIL_COMPARE
enumeratedValue.description: Count until compare, then re-initialize. If counting up, a successful compare occurs when the counter reaches a COMP1 value. If counting down, a successful compare occurs when the counter reaches a COMP2 value. When output mode $4 is used, alternating values of COMP1 and COMP2 are used to generate successful comparisons. For example, the counter counts until a COMP1 value is reached, re-initializes, counts until COMP2 value is reached, re-initializes, counts until COMP1 value is reached, and so on.

enumeratedValue.name: UNTIL_COMPARE
enumeratedValue.description: Count until compare and then stop. If counting up, a successful compare occurs when the counter reaches a COMP1 value. If counting down, a successful compare occurs when the counter reaches a COMP2 value. When output mode $4 is used, the counter re-initializes after reaching the COMP1 value, continues to count to the COMP2 value, and then stops.

enumeratedValue.name: BUS_DIVBY1
enumeratedValue.description: IP bus clock divide by 1 prescaler

enumeratedValue.name: BUS_DIVBY2
enumeratedValue.description: IP bus clock divide by 2 prescaler

enumeratedValue.name: BUS_DIVBY4
enumeratedValue.description: IP bus clock divide by 4 prescaler

enumeratedValue.name: UNTIL_ROLLOVER
enumeratedValue.description: Count until roll over at $FFFF and continue from $0000.

enumeratedValue.name: UNTIL_COMPARE
enumeratedValue.description: Count until compare, then re-initialize. If counting up, a successful compare occurs when the counter reaches a COMP1 value. If counting down, a successful compare occurs when the counter reaches a COMP2 value. When output mode $4 is used, alternating values of COMP1 and COMP2 are used to generate successful comparisons. For example, the counter counts until a COMP1 value is reached, re-initializes, counts until COMP2 value is reached, re-initializes, counts until COMP1 value is reached, and so on.

enumeratedValue.name: UNTIL_COMPARE
enumeratedValue.description: Count until compare and then stop. If counting up, a successful compare occurs when the counter reaches a COMP1 value. If counting down, a successful compare occurs when the counter reaches a COMP2 value. When output mode $4 is used, the counter re-initializes after reaching the COMP1 value, continues to count to the COMP2 value, and then stops.

field.name: OM1
field.description: Output Compare Operating Mode for Channel 1

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Output disabled. No response on pin.

enumeratedValue.name: PULSE
enumeratedValue.description: Generate a low pulse that is one input clock cycle wide on the output pin. When OMn is first programmed as 1xx, the output pin is set to one immediately on the next input clock (if it was not one already). "Input clock" here refers to the clock selected by the CLKSRC field of this register.

field.name: RXCLKSRC
field.description: Sample Clock source selection for Flash Reading

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: Dummy Read strobe generated by FlexSPI Controller and loopback internally.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Dummy Read strobe generated by FlexSPI Controller and loopback from DQS pad.

enumeratedValue.name: val3
enumeratedValue.description: Flash provided Read strobe and input from DQS pad

field.name: ARDFEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus Read Access to IP RX FIFO.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: IP RX FIFO should be read by IP Bus. AHB Bus read access to IP RX FIFO memory space will get bus error response.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: IP RX FIFO should be read by AHB Bus. IP Bus read access to IP RX FIFO memory space will always return data zero but no bus error response.

field.name: ATDFEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus Write Access to IP TX FIFO.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: IP TX FIFO should be written by IP Bus. AHB Bus write access to IP TX FIFO memory space will get bus error response.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: IP TX FIFO should be written by AHB Bus. IP Bus write access to IP TX FIFO memory space will be ignored but no bus error response.

field.name: HSEN
field.description: Half Speed Serial Flash access Enable.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable divide by 2 of serial flash clock for half speed commands.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable divide by 2 of serial flash clock for half speed commands.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: Doze mode support disabled. AHB clock and serial clock will not be gated off when there is doze mode request from system.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Doze mode support enabled. AHB clock and serial clock will be gated off when there is doze mode request from system.

field.name: COMBINATIONEN
field.description: This bit is to support Flash Octal mode access by combining Port A and B Data pins (A_DATA[3:0] and B_DATA[3:0]), when Port A and Port B are of 4 bit data width.

field.name: SCKFREERUNEN
field.description: This bit is used to force SCLK output free-running. For FPGA applications, external device may use SCLK as reference clock to its internal PLL.

field.name: IPGRANTWAIT
field.description: Timeout wait cycle for IP command grant.

field.name: AHBGRANTWAIT
field.description: Timeout wait cycle for AHB command grant.

field.name: SEQWAIT
field.description: Command Sequence Execution will timeout and abort after SEQWAIT * 1024 Serial Root Clock cycles. When sequence execution timeout occurs, there will be an interrupt generated (INTR[SEQTIMEOUT]) if this interrupt is enabled (INTEN[SEQTIMEOUTEN] is set 0x1) and AHB command is ignored by arbitrator.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: AHB RX/TX Buffer will not be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI return Stop mode ACK.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: AHB RX/TX Buffer will be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI return Stop mode ACK.

field.name: SAMEDEVICEEN
field.description: All external devices are same devices (both in types and size) for A1/A2/B1/B2.

enumeratedValue.name: individual_parallel
enumeratedValue.description: In Individual mode, FLSHA1CRx/FLSHA2CRx/FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx register setting will be applied to Flash A1/A2/B1/B2 separately. In Parallel mode, FLSHA1CRx register setting will be applied to Flash A1 and B1, FLSHA2CRx register setting will be applied to Flash A2 and B2. FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx register settings will be ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: FLSHA1CR0/FLSHA1CR1/FLSHA1CR2 register settings will be applied to Flash A1/A2/B1/B2. FLSHA2CRx/FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx will be ignored.

field.name: SCKBDIFFOPT
field.description: B_SCLK pad can be used as A_SCLK differential clock output (inverted clock to A_SCLK). In this case, port B flash access is not available. After changing the value of this field, MCR0[SWRESET] should be set.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: B_SCLK pad is used as port B SCLK clock output. Port B flash access is available.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: B_SCLK pad is used as port A SCLK inverted clock output (Differential clock to A_SCLK). Port B flash access is not available.

field.name: RESUMEWAIT
field.description: Wait cycle (in AHB clock cycle) for idle state before suspended command sequence resumed.

field.name: APAREN
field.description: Parallel mode enabled for AHB triggered Command (both read and write).

enumeratedValue.name: individual
enumeratedValue.description: Flash will be accessed in Individual mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Flash will be accessed in Parallel mode.

field.name: CLRAHBRXBUF
field.description: Clear the status/pointers of AHB RX Buffer. Auto-cleared.

field.name: CLRAHBTXBUF
field.description: Clear the status/pointers of AHB TX Buffer. Auto-cleared.

field.name: CACHABLEEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus cachable read access support.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. When there is AHB bus cachable read access, FlexSPI will not check whether it hit AHB TX Buffer.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. When there is AHB bus cachable read access, FlexSPI will check whether it hit AHB TX Buffer first.

field.name: BUFFERABLEEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus bufferable write access support.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. For all AHB write access (no matter bufferable or non-bufferable ), FlexSPI will return AHB Bus ready after all data is transmitted to External device and AHB command finished.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. For AHB bufferable write access, FlexSPI will return AHB Bus ready when the AHB command is granted by arbitrator and will not wait for AHB command finished.

field.name: READADDROPT
field.description: AHB Read Address option bit. This option bit is intend to remove AHB burst start address alignment limitation.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: There is AHB read burst start address alignment limitation when flash is accessed in parallel mode or flash is word-addressable.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: There is no AHB read burst start address alignment limitation. FlexSPI will fetch more data than AHB burst required to meet the alignment requirement.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: AHB read size will be decided by other register setting like PREFETCH_EN

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: AHB read size to up size to 8 bytes aligned, no prefetching

field.name: IPCMDDONEEN
field.description: IP triggered Command Sequences Execution finished interrupt enable.

field.name: IPCMDGEEN
field.description: IP triggered Command Sequences Grant Timeout interrupt enable.

field.name: AHBCMDGEEN
field.description: AHB triggered Command Sequences Grant Timeout interrupt enable.

field.name: IPCMDERREN
field.description: IP triggered Command Sequences Error Detected interrupt enable.

field.name: AHBCMDERREN
field.description: AHB triggered Command Sequences Error Detected interrupt enable.

field.name: IPRXWAEN
field.description: IP RX FIFO WaterMark available interrupt enable.

field.name: IPTXWEEN
field.description: IP TX FIFO WaterMark empty interrupt enable.

field.name: SCKSTOPBYRDEN
field.description: SCLK is stopped during command sequence because Async RX FIFO full interrupt enable.

field.name: SCKSTOPBYWREN
field.description: SCLK is stopped during command sequence because Async TX FIFO empty interrupt enable.

field.name: IPCMDDONE
field.description: IP triggered Command Sequences Execution finished interrupt. This interrupt is also generated when there is IPCMDGE or IPCMDERR interrupt generated.

field.name: IPCMDGE
field.description: IP triggered Command Sequences Grant Timeout interrupt.

field.name: AHBCMDGE
field.description: AHB triggered Command Sequences Grant Timeout interrupt.

field.name: IPCMDERR
field.description: IP triggered Command Sequences Error Detected interrupt. When an error detected for IP command, this command will be ignored and not executed at all.

field.name: AHBCMDERR
field.description: AHB triggered Command Sequences Error Detected interrupt. When an error detected for AHB command, this command will be ignored and not executed at all.

field.name: IPRXWA
field.description: IP RX FIFO watermark available interrupt.

field.name: IPTXWE
field.description: IP TX FIFO watermark empty interrupt.

field.name: SCKSTOPBYRD
field.description: SCLK is stopped during command sequence because Async RX FIFO full interrupt.

field.name: SCKSTOPBYWR
field.description: SCLK is stopped during command sequence because Async TX FIFO empty interrupt.

field.name: KEY
field.description: The Key to lock or unlock LUT.

field.name: BUFSZ
field.description: AHB RX Buffer Size in 64 bits.

field.name: MSTRID
field.description: This AHB RX Buffer is assigned according to AHB Master with ID (MSTR_ID).

field.name: PRIORITY
field.description: This priority for AHB Master Read which this AHB RX Buffer is assigned. 7 is the highest priority, 0 the lowest.

field.name: REGIONEN

field.name: PREFETCHEN

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: The CS interval unit is 1 serial clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: The CS interval unit is 256 serial clock cycle

field.name: CSINTERVAL
field.description: This field is used to set the minimum interval between flash device Chip selection deassertion and flash device Chip selection assertion. If external flash has a limitation on the interval between command sequences, this field should be set accordingly. If there is no limitation, set this field with value 0x0.

field.name: ARDSEQID
field.description: Sequence Index for AHB Read triggered Command in LUT.

field.name: ARDSEQNUM
field.description: Sequence Number for AHB Read triggered Command in LUT.

field.name: AWRSEQID
field.description: Sequence Index for AHB Write triggered Command.

field.name: AWRSEQNUM
field.description: Sequence Number for AHB Write triggered Command.

field.name: AWRWAIT
field.description: For certain devices (such as FPGA), it need some time to write data into internal memory after the command sequences finished on FlexSPI interface. If another Read command sequence comes before previous programming finished internally, the read data may be wrong. This field is used to hold AHB Bus ready for AHB write access to wait the programming finished in external device. Then there will be no AHB read command triggered before the programming finished in external device. The Wait cycle between AHB triggered command sequences finished on FlexSPI interface and AHB return Bus ready: AWRWAIT * AWRWAITUNIT

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 2 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 8 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: val2
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 32 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: val3
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 128 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: val4
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 512 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: val5
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 2048 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: val6
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 8192 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.description: Any bytes following the IP payload section of the frame are removed from the frame.

field.name: IPDIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With Wrong IPv4 Header Checksum

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with wrong IPv4 header checksum are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: If an IPv4 frame is received with a mismatching header checksum, the frame is discarded. IPv6 has no header checksum and is not affected by this setting. Discarding is only available when the RX FIFO operates in store and forward mode (RSFL cleared).

field.name: PRODIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With Wrong Protocol Checksum

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with wrong checksum are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: If a TCP/IP, UDP/IP, or ICMP/IP frame is received that has a wrong TCP, UDP, or ICMP checksum, the frame is discarded. Discarding is only available when the RX FIFO operates in store and forward mode (RSFL cleared).

field.name: LINEDIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With MAC Layer Errors

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with errors are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Any frame received with a CRC, length, or PHY error is automatically discarded and not forwarded to the user application interface.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: Instructs the MAC to write two additional bytes in front of each frame received into the RX FIFO.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The timer stops at the current value.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The timer can be reset to zero when the given offset time is reached (offset event). The field is cleared when the offset event is reached, so no further event occurs until the field is set again. The timer offset value must be set before setting this field.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The timer is not affected and no action occurs, besides clearing OFFEN, when the offset is reached.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: If OFFEN is set, the timer resets to zero when the offset setting is reached. The offset event does not cause a timer interrupt.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: A period event interrupt can be generated (EIR[TS_TIMER]) and the event signal output is asserted when the timer wraps around according to the periodic setting ATPER. The timer period value must be set before setting this bit. Not all devices contain the event signal output. See the chip configuration details.

field.name: PINPER
field.description: Enables event signal output external pin frc_evt_period assertion on period event

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The current time is captured and can be read from the ATVR register.

enumeratedValue.name: ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: The timer is active and all configuration fields in this register are relevant.

enumeratedValue.name: ONE
enumeratedValue.description: The internal timer is disabled and the externally provided timer value is used. All other fields, except CAPTURE, in this register have no effect. CAPTURE can still be used to capture the current timer value.
