field.description: General Purpose Timer Mode In one shot mode, the timer will count down to zero, generate an interrupt, and stop until the counter is reset by software; In repeat mode, the timer will count down to zero, generate an interrupt and automatically reload the counter value from GPTLD bits to start again

enumeratedValue.description: Load counter value from GPTLD bits in n_GPTIMER0LD

field.name: GPTRUN

enumeratedValue.name: N_CC_1

field.name: DEN

enumeratedValue.name: ASE_1

field.name: NAKE

field.name: UPIE

field.name: CH0_IRQ_MERGED
field.description: Indicates that the interrupt for channel 0 must be merged with the other interrupts on the shared dcp_irq interrupt

field.name: ENABLE_CHANNEL
field.description: Setting a bit in this field enables the DMA channel associated with it

field.name: NUM_KEYS
field.description: Encoded value indicating the number of key-storage locations implemented in the design

field.name: NUM_CHANNELS
field.description: Encoded value indicating the number of channels implemented in the design

field.name: DISABLE_UNIQUE_KEY
field.description: Write to a 1 to disable the per-device unique key

field.name: DISABLE_DECRYPT
field.description: Write to 1 to disable the decryption

field.name: CIPHER_ALGORITHMS
field.description: One-hot field indicating which cipher algorithms are available

field.name: HASH_ALGORITHMS
field.description: One-hot field indicating which hashing features are implemented in the hardware

field.name: INDEX
field.description: Key index pointer. The valid indices are 0-[number_keys].

field.name: DATA
field.description: Word 0 data for the key. This is the least-significant word.

field.name: INTERRUPT
field.description: Reflects whether the channel must issue an interrupt upon the completion of the packet.

field.name: DECR_SEMAPHORE
field.description: Reflects whether the channel's semaphore must be decremented at the end of the current operation

field.name: CHAIN
field.description: Reflects whether the next command pointer register must be loaded into the channel's current descriptor pointer

field.name: CHAIN_CONTIGUOUS
field.description: Reflects whether the next packet's address is located following this packet's payload.

field.name: ENABLE_MEMCOPY
field.description: Reflects whether the selected memory-copy (memcopy) function should be enabled for this operation.

field.name: ENABLE_CIPHER
field.description: Reflects whether the selected cipher function must be enabled for this operation.

field.name: ENABLE_HASH
field.description: Reflects whether the selected hashing function must be enabled for this operation.

field.name: ENABLE_BLIT
field.description: Reflects whether the DCP must perform a blit operation

field.name: CIPHER_ENCRYPT
field.description: When the cipher block is enabled, this bit indicates whether the operation is encryption or decryption

field.name: CIPHER_INIT
field.description: Reflects whether the cipher block must load the initialization vector from the payload for this operation

field.name: OTP_KEY
field.description: Reflects whether a hardware-based key must be used

field.name: PAYLOAD_KEY
field.description: When set, it indicates the payload contains the key

field.name: HASH_INIT
field.description: Reflects whether the current hashing block is the initial block in the hashing operation, so the hash registers must be initialized before the operation

field.name: HASH_TERM
field.description: Reflects whether the current hashing block is the final block in the hashing operation, so the hash padding must be applied by the hardware

field.name: CHECK_HASH
field.description: Reflects whether the calculated hash value must be compared to the hash provided in the payload.

field.name: HASH_OUTPUT
field.description: When the hashing is enabled, this bit controls whether the input or output data is hashed.

field.name: CONSTANT_FILL
field.description: When this bit is set (MEMCOPY and BLIT modes only), the DCP simply fills the destination buffer with the value found in the source address field

field.name: TEST_SEMA_IRQ
field.description: This bit is used to test the channel semaphore transition to 0. FOR TEST USE ONLY!

field.name: KEY_BYTESWAP
field.description: Reflects whether the DCP engine swaps the key bytes (big-endian key).

field.name: KEY_WORDSWAP
field.description: Reflects whether the DCP engine swaps the key words (big-endian key).

field.name: INPUT_BYTESWAP
field.description: Reflects whether the DCP engine byteswaps the input data (big-endian data).

field.name: INPUT_WORDSWAP
field.description: Reflects whether the DCP engine wordswaps the input data (big-endian data).

field.name: OUTPUT_BYTESWAP
field.description: Reflects whether the DCP engine byteswaps the output data (big-endian data).

field.name: OUTPUT_WORDSWAP
field.description: Reflects whether the DCP engine wordswaps the output data (big-endian data).

field.name: CIPHER_MODE
field.description: Cipher mode selection field. Reflects the mode of operation for the cipher operations.

field.name: CIPHER_CFG
field.description: Cipher configuration bits. Optional configuration bits are required for the ciphers.

field.name: COUNT
field.description: Byte count register. This value is the working value and updates as the operation proceeds.

field.name: ADDR
field.description: This regiser reflects the payload pointer for the current control packet.

register.name: CH0CMDPTR
register.description: DCP channel 0 command pointer address register

field.name: ADDR
field.description: Pointer to the descriptor structure to be processed for channel 0.

field.name: INCREMENT
field.description: The value written to this field is added to the semaphore count in an atomic way such that the simultaneous software adds and DCP hardware substracts happening on the same clock are protected

field.name: VALUE
field.description: This read-only field shows the current (instantaneous) value of the semaphore counter.

field.name: HASH_MISMATCH
field.description: This bit indicates that a hashing check operation mismatched for the control packets that enable the HASH_CHECK bit

field.name: ERROR_SETUP
field.description: This bit indicates that the hardware detected an invalid programming configuration (such as a buffer length that is not a multiple of the natural data size for the operation)

field.name: ERROR_PACKET
field.description: This bit indicates that a bus error occurred when reading the packet or payload, or when writing the status back to the packet payload

field.name: ERROR_SRC
field.description: This bit indicates that a bus error occurred when reading from the source buffer

field.name: ERROR_DST
field.description: This bit indicates that a bus error occurred when storing to the destination buffer

field.name: ERROR_PAGEFAULT
field.description: This bit indicates that a page fault occurred while converting a virtual address to a physical address

field.name: ERROR_CODE
field.description: Indicates the additional error codes for some of the error conditions

enumeratedValue.name: NEXT_CHAIN_IS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Error signalled because the next pointer is 0x00000000

enumeratedValue.name: NO_CHAIN
enumeratedValue.description: Error signalled because the semaphore is non-zero and neither chain bit is set

enumeratedValue.name: CONTEXT_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: Error signalled because an error is reported reading/writing the context buffer

enumeratedValue.name: PAYLOAD_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: Error signalled because an error is reported reading/writing the payload

enumeratedValue.name: INVALID_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: Error signalled because the control packet specifies an invalid mode select (for instance, blit + hash)

enumeratedValue.description: No Watchdog timeout interrupt has occurred

field.name: XNE
field.description: Use Negative Edge of INDEX Pulse

enumeratedValue.name: XNE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Use positive edge of INDEX pulse

enumeratedValue.name: XNE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Use negative edge of INDEX pulse

field.name: XIP
field.description: INDEX Triggered Initialization of Position Counters UPOS and LPOS

enumeratedValue.name: XIP_0
enumeratedValue.description: INDEX pulse does not initialize the position counter

enumeratedValue.name: XIP_1
enumeratedValue.description: INDEX pulse initializes the position counter

enumeratedValue.name: PH1_0
enumeratedValue.description: Use the standard quadrature decoder, where PHASEA and PHASEB represent a two-phase quadrature signal.

enumeratedValue.name: PH1_1
enumeratedValue.description: Bypass the quadrature decoder. A positive transition of the PHASEA input generates a count signal. The PHASEB input and the REV bit control the counter direction: If CTRL[REV] = 0, PHASEB = 0, then count up If CTRL[REV] = 1, PHASEB = 1, then count up If CTRL[REV] = 0, PHASEB = 1, then count down If CTRL[REV] = 1, PHASEB = 0, then count down

field.name: SWIP
field.description: Software-Triggered Initialization of Position Counters UPOS and LPOS

enumeratedValue.name: SWIP_1
enumeratedValue.description: Initialize position counter (using upper and lower initialization registers, UINIT and LINIT)

field.name: HNE
field.description: Use Negative Edge of HOME Input

enumeratedValue.name: HNE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Use positive-going edge-to-trigger initialization of position counters UPOS and LPOS

enumeratedValue.name: HNE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Use negative-going edge-to-trigger initialization of position counters UPOS and LPOS

field.name: HIP
field.description: Enable HOME to Initialize Position Counters UPOS and LPOS

enumeratedValue.name: HIP_1
enumeratedValue.description: HOME signal initializes the position counter

enumeratedValue.name: HIRQ_0
enumeratedValue.description: No transition on the HOME signal has occurred

enumeratedValue.name: HIRQ_1
enumeratedValue.description: A transition on the HOME signal has occurred

field.name: FILT_PRSC
field.description: prescaler divide IPbus clock to FILT clk

enumeratedValue.name: QDN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Generates a positive quadrature decoder signal

enumeratedValue.name: QDN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Generates a negative quadrature decoder signal

enumeratedValue.name: UPDHLD_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable updates of hold registers on the rising edge of TRIGGER input signal

enumeratedValue.name: UPDHLD_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable updates of hold registers on the rising edge of TRIGGER input signal

enumeratedValue.name: UPDPOS_0
enumeratedValue.description: No action for POSD, REV, UPOS and LPOS registers on rising edge of TRIGGER

enumeratedValue.name: UPDPOS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Clear POSD, REV, UPOS and LPOS registers on rising edge of TRIGGER

enumeratedValue.name: DIR_0
enumeratedValue.description: Last count was in the down direction

enumeratedValue.name: DIR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Last count was in the up direction

enumeratedValue.name: REVMOD_0
enumeratedValue.description: Use INDEX pulse to increment/decrement revolution counter (REV)

enumeratedValue.name: REVMOD_1
enumeratedValue.description: Use modulus counting roll-over/under to increment/decrement revolution counter (REV)

enumeratedValue.name: OUTCTL_0
enumeratedValue.description: POSMATCH pulses when a match occurs between the position counters (POS) and the corresponding compare value (COMP )

enumeratedValue.name: OUTCTL_1
enumeratedValue.description: POSMATCH pulses when the UPOS, LPOS, REV, or POSD registers are read

cluster.name: SM[%s]
cluster.description: Array of registers: SMCAPTCOMPA, SMCAPTCOMPB, SMCAPTCOMPX, SMCAPTCTRLA, SMCAPTCTRLB, SMCAPTCTRLX, SMCNT, SMCTRL, SMCTRL2, SMCVAL0, SMCVAL0CYC, SMCVAL1, SMCVAL1CYC, SMCVAL2, SMCVAL2CYC, SMCVAL3, SMCVAL3CYC, SMCVAL4, SMCVAL4CYC, SMCVAL5, SMCVAL5CYC, SMDISMAP0, SMDMAEN, SMDTCNT0, SMDTCNT1, SMFRACVAL1, SMFRACVAL2, SMFRACVAL3, SMFRACVAL4, SMFRACVAL5, SMFRCTRL, SMINIT, SMINTEN, SMOCTRL, SMSTS, SMTCTRL, SMVAL0, SMVAL1, SMVAL2, SMVAL3, SMVAL4, SMVAL5

enumeratedValue.name: IPBUS
enumeratedValue.description: The IPBus clock is used as the clock for the local prescaler and counter.

enumeratedValue.name: EXT_CLK
enumeratedValue.description: EXT_CLK is used as the clock for the local prescaler and counter.

enumeratedValue.name: AUX_CLK
enumeratedValue.description: Submodule 0's clock (AUX_CLK) is used as the source clock for the local prescaler and counter. This setting should not be used in submodule 0 as it will force the clock to logic 0.

enumeratedValue.name: LOCAL
enumeratedValue.description: The local RELOAD signal is used to reload registers.

enumeratedValue.name: MASTER
enumeratedValue.description: The master RELOAD signal (from submodule 0) is used to reload registers. This setting should not be used in submodule 0 as it will force the RELOAD signal to logic 0.

field.name: FORCE_SEL
field.description: This read/write bit determines the source of the FORCE OUTPUT signal for this submodule.

enumeratedValue.name: LOCAL
enumeratedValue.description: The local force signal, CTRL2[FORCE], from this submodule is used to force updates.

enumeratedValue.name: MASTER
enumeratedValue.description: The master force signal from submodule 0 is used to force updates. This setting should not be used in submodule 0 as it will hold the FORCE OUTPUT signal to logic 0.

enumeratedValue.name: LOCAL_RELOAD
enumeratedValue.description: The local reload signal from this submodule is used to force updates without regard to the state of LDOK.

enumeratedValue.name: MASTER_RELOAD
enumeratedValue.description: The master reload signal from submodule0 is used to force updates if LDOK is set. This setting should not be used in submodule0 as it will hold the FORCE OUTPUT signal to logic 0.

enumeratedValue.name: LOCAL_SYNC
enumeratedValue.description: The local sync signal from this submodule is used to force updates.

enumeratedValue.name: MASTER_SYNC
enumeratedValue.description: The master sync signal from submodule0 is used to force updates. This setting should not be used in submodule0 as it will hold the FORCE OUTPUT signal to logic 0.

enumeratedValue.name: EXT_FORCE
enumeratedValue.description: The external force signal, EXT_FORCE, from outside the PWM module causes updates.

enumeratedValue.name: EXT_SYNC
enumeratedValue.description: The external sync signal, EXT_SYNC, from outside the PWM module causes updates.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Initialization from a FORCE_OUT is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Initialization from a FORCE_OUT is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: MASTER_RELOAD
enumeratedValue.description: Master reload from submodule 0 causes initialization. This setting should not be used in submodule 0 as it will force the INIT signal to logic 0. The submodule counter will only reinitialize when a master reload occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: MASTER_SYNC
enumeratedValue.description: Master sync from submodule 0 causes initialization. This setting should not be used in submodule 0 as it will force the INIT signal to logic 0.

enumeratedValue.name: COMPLEMENTARY
enumeratedValue.description: PWM_A and PWM_B form a complementary PWM pair.

enumeratedValue.name: INDEPENDENT
enumeratedValue.description: PWM_A and PWM_B outputs are independent PWMs.

enumeratedValue.name: NEXT_PWM_RELOAD
enumeratedValue.description: Buffered registers of this submodule are loaded and take effect at the next PWM reload if MCTRL[LDOK] is set.

enumeratedValue.name: MTCTRL_LDOK_SET
enumeratedValue.description: Buffered registers of this submodule are loaded and take effect immediately upon MCTRL[LDOK] being set. In this case it is not necessary to set CTRL[FULL] or CTRL[HALF].

field.name: SPLIT
field.description: Split the DBLPWM signal to PWMA and PWMB

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: DBLPWM is not split. PWMA and PWMB each have double pulses.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: DBLPWM is split to PWMA and PWMB.

enumeratedValue.name: EQUAL_TO
enumeratedValue.description: The VAL* registers and the PWM counter are compared using an "equal to" method. This means that PWM edges are only produced when the counter is equal to one of the VAL* register values. This implies that a PWMA output that is high at the end of a period will maintain this state until a match with VAL3 clears the output in the following period.

enumeratedValue.name: EQUAL_TO_OR_GREATER_THAN
enumeratedValue.description: The VAL* registers and the PWM counter are compared using an "equal to or greater than" method. This means that PWM edges are produced when the counter is equal to or greater than one of the VAL* register values. This implies that a PWMA output that is high at the end of a period could go low at the start of the next period if the starting counter value is greater than (but not necessarily equal to) the new VAL3 value.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disable fractional cycle length for the PWM period.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enable fractional cycle length for the PWM period.

field.name: FRAC23_EN
field.description: Fractional Cycle Placement Enable for PWM_A

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disable fractional cycle placement for PWM_A.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enable fractional cycle placement for PWM_A.

field.name: FRAC45_EN
field.description: Fractional Cycle Placement Enable for PWM_B

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disable fractional cycle placement for PWM_B.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enable fractional cycle placement for PWM_B.

enumeratedValue.name: LOGIC_0
enumeratedValue.description: Output is forced to logic 0 state prior to consideration of output polarity control.

enumeratedValue.name: LOGIC_1
enumeratedValue.description: Output is forced to logic 1 state prior to consideration of output polarity control.

enumeratedValue.name: LOGIC_0
enumeratedValue.description: Output is forced to logic 0 state prior to consideration of output polarity control.

enumeratedValue.name: LOGIC_1
enumeratedValue.description: Output is forced to logic 1 state prior to consideration of output polarity control.

enumeratedValue.name: LOGIC_0
enumeratedValue.description: Output is forced to logic 0 state prior to consideration of output polarity control.

enumeratedValue.name: LOGIC_1
enumeratedValue.description: Output is forced to logic 1 state prior to consideration of output polarity control.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_INVERTED
enumeratedValue.description: PWM_X output not inverted. A high level on the PWM_X pin represents the "on" or "active" state.

enumeratedValue.name: INVERTED
enumeratedValue.description: PWM_X output inverted. A low level on the PWM_X pin represents the "on" or "active" state.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_INVERTED
enumeratedValue.description: PWM_B output not inverted. A high level on the PWM_B pin represents the "on" or "active" state.

enumeratedValue.name: INVERTED
enumeratedValue.description: PWM_B output inverted. A low level on the PWM_B pin represents the "on" or "active" state.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_INVERTED
enumeratedValue.description: PWM_A output not inverted. A high level on the PWM_A pin represents the "on" or "active" state.

enumeratedValue.name: INVERTED
enumeratedValue.description: PWM_A output inverted. A low level on the PWM_A pin represents the "on" or "active" state.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_EVENT
enumeratedValue.description: No compare event has occurred for a particular VALx value.

enumeratedValue.name: EVENT
enumeratedValue.description: A compare event has occurred for a particular VALx value.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_FLAG
enumeratedValue.description: No new reload cycle since last STS[RF] clearing

enumeratedValue.name: FLAG
enumeratedValue.description: New reload cycle since last STS[RF] clearing

enumeratedValue.name: FLAG
enumeratedValue.description: Reload signal occurred with non-coherent data and MCTRL[LDOK] = 0.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_FLAG
enumeratedValue.description: No register update has occurred since last reload.

enumeratedValue.name: NORMAL
enumeratedValue.description: Normal mode. PWM outputs disabled by this fault are not enabled until FSTS[FFLAGx] is clear at the start of a half cycle or full cycle depending on the states of FSTS[FHALF] and FSTS[FFULL] without regard to the state of FSTS[FFPINx]. If neither FHALF nor FFULL is set then the fault condition cannot be cleared. The PWM outputs disabled by this fault input will not be re-enabled until the actual FAULTx input signal de-asserts since the fault input will combinationally disable the PWM outputs (as programmed in DISMAPn).

enumeratedValue.name: SAFE
enumeratedValue.description: Safe mode. PWM outputs disabled by this fault are not enabled until FSTS[FFLAGx] is clear and FSTS[FFPINx] is clear at the start of a half cycle or full cycle depending on the states of FSTS[FHALF] and FSTS[FFULL]. If neither FHLAF nor FFULL is set, then the fault condition cannot be cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: MANUAL
enumeratedValue.description: Manual fault clearing. PWM outputs disabled by this fault are not enabled until FSTS[FFLAGx] is clear at the start of a half cycle or full cycle depending the states of FSTS[FHALF] and FSTS[FFULL]. If neither FFULL nor FHALF is set, then the fault condition cannot be cleared. This is further controlled by FCTRL[FSAFE].

enumeratedValue.name: AUTOMATIC
enumeratedValue.description: Automatic fault clearing. PWM outputs disabled by this fault are enabled when FSTS[FFPINx] is clear at the start of a half cycle or full cycle depending on the states of FSTS[FHALF] and FSTS[FFULL] without regard to the state of FSTS[FFLAGx]. If neither FFULL nor FHALF is set, then the fault condition cannot be cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: LOGIC_0
enumeratedValue.description: A logic 0 on the fault input indicates a fault condition.

enumeratedValue.name: LOGIC_1
enumeratedValue.description: A logic 1 on the fault input indicates a fault condition.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_FLAG
enumeratedValue.description: No fault on the FAULTx pin.

enumeratedValue.name: PWM_OUTPUTS_REENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: PWM outputs are re-enabled at the start of a half cycle (as defined by VAL0).

enumeratedValue.description: Fault input glitch stretching is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Input fault signals will be stretched to at least 2 IPBus clock cycles.

field.name: EN
field.description: TCM enable. When a TCM is disabled all accesses are made to the AXIM interface.

field.name: RMW
field.description: Read-Modify-Write (RMW) enable. Indicates that all writes to TCM, that are not the full width of the TCM RAM, use a RMW sequence.

field.name: RETEN
field.description: Retry phase enable. When enabled the processor guarantees to honor the retry output on the corresponding TCM interface, re-executing the instruction which carried out the TCM access.

field.name: SZ
field.description: TCM size. Indicates the size of the relevant TCM.

field.name: EN
field.description: TCM enable. When a TCM is disabled all accesses are made to the AXIM interface.

field.name: RMW

field.name: SZ

enumeratedValue.name: EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: AHBP disabled. When disabled all accesses are made to the AXIM interface.

field.name: SIWT
field.description: Shared cacheable-is-WT for data cache. Enables limited cache coherency usage.

enumeratedValue.name: SIWT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Normal Cacheable Shared locations are treated as being Non-cacheable. Default mode of operation for Shared memory.

enumeratedValue.name: SIWT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Normal Cacheable shared locations are treated as Write-Through.

field.name: ECCDIS
field.description: Enables ECC in the instruction and data cache.

enumeratedValue.name: ECCDIS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Enables ECC in the instruction and data cache.

enumeratedValue.name: ECCDIS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Disables ECC in the instruction and data cache.

field.name: FORCEWT
field.description: Enables Force Write-Through in the data cache.

enumeratedValue.name: FORCEWT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enables Force Write-Through. All Cacheable memory regions are treated as Write-Through.

enumeratedValue.name: CTL_0
enumeratedValue.description: AHBS access priority demoted. This is the reset value.

enumeratedValue.name: CTL_2
enumeratedValue.description: AHBS access priority demoted by initializing the fairness counter to the CM7_AHBSCR[INITCOUNT] value when the software execution priority is higher than or equal to the threshold level programed in CM7_AHBSCR[TPRI].

enumeratedValue.name: CTL_3
enumeratedValue.description: AHBSPRI signal has control of access priority.

field.name: TPRI
field.description: Threshold execution priority for AHBS traffic demotion.

field.name: AXIMTYPE
field.description: Indicates the type of fault on the AXIM interface. Only valid when AXIM is 1.

field.name: INTID
field.description: Interrupt ID of the interrupt to trigger, in the range 0-239. For example, a value of 0x03 specifies interrupt IRQ3.

register.name: TYPE
register.description: The MPU Type Register indicates how many regions the MPU support. Software can use it to determine if the processor implements an MPU.

field.name: SEPARATE
field.description: Indicates support for separate instruction and data address maps. RAZ. Armv7-M only supports a unified MPU

field.name: DREGION
field.description: Number of regions supported by the MPU. If this field reads-as-zero the processor does not implement an MPU.

field.name: IREGION
field.description: Instruction region. RAZ. Armv7-M only supports a unified MPU.

field.name: HFNMIENA
field.description: Controls whether handlers executing with priority less than 0 access memory with the MPU enabled or with the MPU disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Disables the MPU for these handlers.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Use the MPU for memory accesses by these handlers.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Disables the default memory map. Any instruction or data access that does not access a defined region faults.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Enables the default memory map as a background region for privileged access. The background region acts as region number -1. All memory regions configured in the MPU take priority over the default memory map.

field.name: REGION
field.description: Indicates the memory region accessed by MPU_RBAR and MPU_RASR.

field.name: REGION
field.description: On writes, can specify the number of the region to update. On reads, returns bits[3:0] of MPU_RNR.

field.name: VALID
field.description: On writes, indicates whether the region to update is specified by MPU_RNR.REGION, or by the REGION value specified in this write. When using the REGION value specified by this write, MPU_RNR.REGION is updated to this value.

enumeratedValue.name: IGNORE_RBAR_REGION
enumeratedValue.description: Apply the base address update to the region specified by MPU_RNR.REGION. The REGION field value is ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: USE_RBAR_REGION
enumeratedValue.description: Update MPU_RNR.REGION to the value obtained by zero extending the REGION value specified in this write, and apply the base address update to this region.

register.name: RASR
register.description: MPU Region Attribute and Size Register.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: When the MPU is enabled, this region is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: When the MPU is enabled, this region is enabled.

field.name: SIZE
field.description: Indicates the region size. The region size, in bytes, is 2**(SIZE+1). SIZE field values less than 4 are reserved, because the smallest supported region size is 32 bytes.

field.name: SRD
field.description: Subregion Disable. For regions of 256 bytes or larger, each bit of this field controls whether one of the eight equal subregions is enabled. SRD[0-7]=0 - subregion enabled. SRD[0-7]=1 - subregion disabled.

field.name: B
field.description: Memory type attribute B. The TEX[2:0], C, and B bits together indicate the memory type of the region.

field.name: C
field.description: Memory type attribute C. The TEX[2:0], C, and B bits together indicate the memory type of the region.

field.name: S
field.description: For Normal memory regions, the S bit indicates whether the region is shareable. For Strongly-ordered and Device memory, the S bit is ignored.

field.name: TEX
field.description: Memory type attribute TEX. The TEX[2:0], C, and B bits together indicate the memory type of the region

field.name: AP
field.description: The AP[2:0] bits indicate the access and privilege properties of the region.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_ACCESS
enumeratedValue.description: Any access generates a permission fault.

enumeratedValue.name: UNPRIVILEGED_READ_ACCESS
enumeratedValue.description: Any unprivileged write generates a permission fault (Priviledge read/write, unprivileged read-only).

field.name: XN
field.description: The XN bit is an Execute Never bit, that indicates whether the processor can execute instructions from the region.

enumeratedValue.name: EXECUTE
enumeratedValue.description: Execution of an instruction fetched from this region permitted.

enumeratedValue.name: EXECUTE_NEVER
enumeratedValue.description: Execution of an instruction fetched from this region not permitted.
